notes.title: Bridge of Hope, Voidwalker-E1 and Characters
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
Here is progress of the last week.

First of all, I made a prototype of spaceship VOIDWALKER-E1, which travels across the universe and picks up all people, who want to move to the Heaven ahead of their time.

Secondly, I made prototype of Bridge of Hope - the place in front of Complex E station, where frozen clients of OSIRIS corporation are awaiting of the sacramental moment of fulfilling of their inmost wishes.

And of course, I developed a little bit vision of some main characters of the game - Kira Liar and Dr.Wargo

Stay tuned.. and Respect Your Dark Side!

notes.title: OSIRIS. Available via Early Access!
notes.notes:
Good news, dear friends!
OSIRIS is now available on Steam via Early Access mode!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/997000/OSIRIS/

build v01.0021.0004
[list]
[*] 10-15 minutes of gameplay are available (Exploration part and Action part)
[*] 4 deadly guns
[*] 1 type of enemy
[*] sketchy environment of "Complex E" location
[*] original soundtrack by Kwizma https://www.junodownload.com/artists/Kwizma/releases/
[/list]

Overall progress of development equals ~0.5-1% of final goal, so there is a lot of work ahead, which will take ~1.5-2 years.
New locations, enemies, guns, details of environments will be added. Also story characters, new soundtrack, puzzles, Horror part will be added.
Planned duration of final gameplay equals ~3 hours.

Please, share with me your constructive feedback regarding the game: what can be improved, what do you like/dislike and so on.
I try of my best to implement these ideas during further development and make really cool dark sci-fi horror/first person shooter.

ps. I wrote down a lot of feedback regarding previous versions of OSIRIS - step by step I improve these parts of game. Great thanks to everyone who helps me with the development of this project!

And be aware of the first bug: some elements of the interior have not colliders. I will fix it in the next update!

Stay tuned and Respect Your Dark Side!

notes.title: OSIRIS is now on Steam!
notes.notes:
Dear friends, OSIRIS is now on Steam!
Planned release date is 1 April 2019!

Game will be available via Early Access mode.
In the first version of the game there will be next things:
[list]
[*] 10-15 minutes of gameplay: Exploration and Action parts at "Complex E" location
[*] 4 weapons
[*] 1 enemy
[*] 2 Dark Dubstep tracks by Kwizma https://soundcloud.com/kwizma
[/list]

Plans about further development:
[list]
[*] upgrading of "Complex E" location
[*] adding of 6 new locations like "Spaceship", "Ancient Ruins", "Dead Futuristic City", "Hell" and others.
[*] adding of new guns: rocket launcher, grenades, assault rifle, plasma gun and others.
[*] adding of new enemies: various types of zombies, cyborgs and demons.
[*] adding of story elements, characters
[*] adding of new atmospheric Dubstep music
[*] implementation of Horror part
[*] implementation of puzzles and modifications for Exploration part
[*] realization of modifications for Action part
[*] realization of ~3 hours of interesting gameplay
[/list]

Planned duration of Early Access mode (further development) of the game: 18-24 months
Price will be gradually raised as new content and features are available.

Feel free to share your constructive feedback here:
